ownership_notes: Federmann Enterprises Ltd. (FEL) owned ~44.15% of ordinary shares directly/indirectly per the 2022 20-F (older than current; re-check latest 20-F). Foreign private issuer; Israeli-law special-majority rules apply.

French State ~26.06% and Dassault Aviation ~25.2-26.05% (figures differ across secondary sources); shareholders' agreement between the two governs the board; ~46% free float. State/strategic control constrains any take-private.

Groupe Industriel Marcel Dassault (Dassault family) holds ~67.3% of capital and ~79.7% of voting rights (voting figure as of 2025-06-30); Airbus ~10.7%; free float ~21.8%. Family control: a take-private needs the family's consent.

Largest reported holders are institutions below 10% each (BlackRock ~6.9% as of 2025-07-04, Vanguard ~4.0% as of 2025-05-30) per a secondary summary; no state or family controlling stake was reported in the sources reviewed (not verified against Rheinmetall's voting-rights notifications).
Leonardo 25.1% and KfW (80% owned by the German federal government) 25.1% after 2021 transactions; KKR retained ~18% at that time (may have changed since).

Company articles restrict foreign ownership: no foreign person (or persons acting in concert) may hold more than a 15% voting interest. Major-shareholder percentages not established from the sources reviewed.
Investor AB holds ~30.16% of capital and ~39.69% of votes (owns all A shares, 10 votes each) per a secondary summary of Saab's ownership page.
Norwegian State owns ~50.0% of shares (secondary source). State control constrains any take-private.

No majority shareholder per DSV investor relations: holders above 5% are Agility Public Warehousing (Kuwait), Ernst Goehner Stiftung (Switzerland; ~9.9% per a secondary source) and Capital Group (USA).
